description: Tetris-style falling block puzzle with single-player and 1v1 multiplayer mode. Cleared lines send garbage to opponent. 3 difficulty levels, leaderboard, voice chat.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. classic Tetris with neon blocks, a space-themed Tetris with gravity effects, or a nature-themed block puzzle
ui.description: Falling block puzzle — solo or 1v1 multiplayer. Cleared lines send garbage to opponent.

sample_prompts: Create a classic Tetris game with neon glow blocks, line clear animations, and a retro arcade theme
Build a space-themed Tetris where blocks are asteroids and clearing lines creates explosions
Make a nature-themed falling block puzzle with earthy colors, leaf particles, and calming audio
kit_prompt_prefix:
Create a TETRIS falling-block puzzle game as a SINGLE HTML file (public/index.html). ALL game code inline in one <script> tag.

Pre-loaded scripts (DO NOT recreate): socket.io CDN, audio.js, touch.js, engine.js

engine.js APIs: LEFT(), RIGHT(), UP(), DOWN(), ACTION(), keys[], GameNet, GameRTC, GameState, GameLobby, GameAudio, TouchControls.

=== TETRIS GAME RULES ===
- 10-column x 20-row grid
- 7 tetrominoes: I(cyan), O(yellow), T(purple), S(green), Z(red), J(blue), L(orange)
- Rotation: clockwise on UP() or ACTION(). Wall kick if rotation blocked.
- Movement: LEFT()/RIGHT() to move, DOWN() for soft drop, hold DOWN for 500ms = hard drop
- Line clear: completed rows flash then disappear. Score: 1 line=100, 2=300, 3=500, 4(Tetris)=800
- Speed increases every 10 lines cleared
- Game over when new piece can't spawn (stack reached top)

=== MODES ===
- Solo: standard Tetris, play for high score
- 1v1 Multiplayer: two side-by-side boards. Cleared lines send garbage rows to opponent (gray blocks with one gap). Use GameNet for sync.
- Lobby: name input, difficulty selector (Easy/Medium/Hard), Solo vs Multiplayer buttons, leaderboard panel
- Multiplayer flow: GameNet.joinRoom() → GameLobby.showWaitingRoom() → game starts when both ready

=== DIFFICULTY ===
- Easy: slow drop speed, no garbage on start
- Medium: moderate speed, starts with 2 garbage rows
- Hard: fast drop, starts with 4 garbage rows, faster speed ramp

=== VISUALS ===
- Each block type has distinct color with gradient/glow effect
- Ghost piece (translucent) shows where current piece will land
- Line clear animation: flash white then collapse
- Next piece preview (show next 3 pieces)
- Hold piece display
- Dark background with grid lines

=== AUDIO ===
GameAudio.play('land') on piece lock. GameAudio.play('collect') on line clear. GameAudio.play('levelup') on speed increase. GameAudio.play('lose') on game over. GameAudio.play('explode') on Tetris (4 lines). GameAudio.startMusic() for background.

=== LEADERBOARD ===
POST {name: GameState.playerName, score, game: 'Tetris'} to /api/leaderboard on game over. Show top 10 in lobby and game over screen.

DO NOT define LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN/ACTION — engine.js provides them.
DO NOT call io() — use GameNet.
DO NOT create AudioContext — use GameAudio.
